correctness.rationale: Identity (2n+1)^2=1+8T(n) bijectively maps odd prime-power triangular fibers to square roots; valuations and Hensel lifting give zero case p^floor(a/2), square even valuation case 2p^j, otherwise zero. Dyadic congruence T(u)≡T(v) mod 2^alpha forces v=u or −u−1 mod 2^(alpha+1), exactly two distinct preimages per output, including m=1 boundary. CRT multiplies local fibers. Summing fiber k powers over discriminant valuation classes gives local C_(p,a)(k) for every integer k>=1; k=2 simplifies to 4m product(1+a(1−1/p)). Independent exact enumeration confirmed all residues/fibers for m=1..250 and moments k=1..4 and collision totals for every m. This finite replay is supplementary; general proof is symbolic.

final_claim: For every positive m and every residue t, the full 2m-period triangular-number fiber M_m(t) equals twice the product of square-root counts r_(p^a)(1+8t) over odd prime powers p^a||m. All positive fiber moments factor explicitly over these prime powers with a uniform dyadic factor, including collision total 4m product(1+a(1−1/p)); local quadratic-square count determines support and proves Ulness saturation conjectures for all m.
